text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!
choice_data_list:
Zephyr! One more on the slope to finish, 
let's go!
Zephyr! One more on the slope to finish!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ngh, haah!!

With the Sprinters Stakes right around the 
corner, Yamanin Zephyr went through her 
daily training in high spirits.

Her spirit was on the verge of breaking 
before strong rivals at one point, but 
now, being conscious of the wall seems to 
keep her motivation even higher instead.

The renowned Daiichi Ruby had officially 
announced her entry into the upcoming 
Sprinters Stakes, butâ

With how Yamanin Zephyr is right now, she 
will surely be able to keep up, even 
against Senior-class Umamusume.
...It was around that time.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘...To reiterate, according to the 
official announcement made at the press 
conference just now—’"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Tokai Teio, the undefeated Double Crown 
Umamusume, has withdrawn from the Kikuka 
Sho in order to treat her injury—"
Tokai Teio withdraws from the Kikuka Sho

The news spread in the blink of an eye, 
plunging everyone back into the depths of 
despair.
Naturally, Yamanin Zephyr as well—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Regarding Teio-san... Though our targets 
differed, since we both admired the 
'Emperor,' I felt we were like comrades of 
a sort.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So... that's exactly why... Just imagining 
it makes my legs tremble.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Losing sight of that admired back beyond 
the horizon... Just thinking of Teio-san's 
anguish hurts so much...!

Clenching her fists, she trembles 
slightly. She looked as though she might 
collapse at any moment, but—

...Similarly, it looked as though she too 
wished she could just break into a run 
right this instant.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: Do you want to cheer Teio up?
Do you wanna cheer Teio up?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... If I even can, that is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yet what words could I possibly offer...? 
To someone who has been cast into such 
dark depths."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Is there really... nothing anyone can do?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...How can you say that?

I nod and continue. ...There has to be 
something we can do.

It happened just before the summer 
training camp—

Just like how Tokai Teio once encouraged 
Yamanin Zephyr when she wavered before the 
formidable rivals of the Senior Class.

The circumstances might be vastly 
different, as well as their weight and 
difficulty. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes...?
choice_data_list: By connecting, we can make a difference.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: By connecting—

Catching the wind of Tokai Teio, who runs 
in the very same era, Yamanin Zephyr 
gained tremendous momentum.

"To say the opposite could never happen... 
that's just impossible."
choice_data_list:
Besides, it's fine even if there's nothing 
to say.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...If I can't say anything, what am I 
supposed to do?
choice_data_list:
There's a way of conveying it that only 
you can manage.

There's a way of conveying it that only 
you can manage

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(A way of conveying our feelings that only 
we can do—)

And so, Yamanin Zephyr dashed out of the 
room and ran off.

Swiftly, swiftly, swift as the wind, to 
the side of my wounded comrade.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, geez.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The sky feels so far awayâ

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san. ...Um, ...I—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, you saw me looking uncool. Even 
though I talked such a big game before the 
summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I... I can't move forward anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can never become an "Undefeated Triple 
Crown Umamusume"... anymore.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...To tell the truth... I've never even 
thought about it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I was merely yearning. Wishing with all 
my heart to become that very wind I once 
saw—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Surpassing" the "Emperor" I so admired... 
...I had never even considered it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However, hearing your words... it felt as 
though my eyes were finally opened.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, so this, too... must be a change 
brought about by our connection. Just as 
Trainer-san said...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...In that case, if we are capable of 
doing it—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I... will surpass the "Emperor", without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The sprint races. The mile races.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And... conquer the medium-distance turf—a 
realm beyond even the storm of that 
legendary "Emperor of the Mile."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
――By achieving the "Triple Crown across 
three categories," I shall truly become 
the one and only wind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
First, next week at the Sprinters 
Stakes... I will show you my raging soul.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"That is why. ...Would you please come and 
watch?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ......You're terrible, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're aiming to surpass the 
"Emperor," and you're asking me to come 
watch?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I can't do that anymore?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I have no words. There is nothing left... 
to be said here.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...That is all I have to say.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I will be waiting for you... at the 
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, man. That's just awful, really.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because you won't ever, ever tell me that 
it's okay to give up—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(We have our own way of conveying our 
feelings, a way only we can do.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (—To us,)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There are feelings that can only be 
conveyed through running.
